items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
a 1928 bronxville house with a stone wall and a whole perennial garden out front. it's giving storybook!!
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.

items.title: "Calling All the Monsters" is back
items.creator: China Anne McClain
items.body: the old disney channel halloween song has 805K+ videos on tiktok rn. everyone born after like 1998 is losing it.

items.title: "my decoration is alive"
items.body: someone poses next to a porch skeleton and then the "skeleton" turns its head and waves. usually set to "Goo Goo Muck." it gets me every single time.

items.title: "Message From A"
items.body: pretty little liars sound + an on-screen note signed "-A" calling out one very specific habit. the callouts are SO personal.

items.title: "things you should definitely ghost"
items.body: someone in a white sheet ghost costume holds up signs of bad habits and red flags to drop. very cute, very halloween.

items.title: "lock in"
items.body: means getting seriously focused, like studying for finals or a big game. it's the gen alpha version of "head down, let's go."

items.title: "crash out"
items.body: means totally losing it and reacting way too dramatically. like a whole meltdown over a group chat.

items.title: "cooked"
items.body: means you're in trouble or basically doomed. forgot the project was due today? cooked.

items.title: "fanum tax"
items.body: when someone takes a little cut of your food, like a fry or two. it comes from a streamer known for stealing food off people's plates.
